newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Chemicals shares power ahead on Budapest bourse.
newsitem.headline: Chemicals shares power ahead on Budapest bourse.

text.p: Hungarian chemicals shares stole the show from pharmaceuticals papers on the Budapest bourse on Wednesday reflecting a tendency among investors to give more room to chemicals in their portfolio, traders said.
"The pharmaceuticals papers were the bourse's flagships during the whole of last year and the fact that there are minor changes in portfolios does not mean any selling wave in them," a salesman said.
"But if we look at the differentials between the price gains of chemicals and pharmaceuticals stocks since the beginning of the year, we can see this mild shift."
On a rising market on Wednesday chemicals stock Borsodchem was one of the day's strongest gainers as it leapt almost 10 percent to record levels.
Borsodchem soared to a new high of 5,160 forints. It closed at 5,160 forints, up 445.
The market's other chemical issue, TVK rose less rapidly but it also hit a new record of 2,370 forints. It closed at 2,365, up 115.

Pharmaceuticals Egis also put on strong gains to finish at 10,900 forints, up 750, while Richter jumped to a daily but not all-time high of 10,795 forints before ending at 10,790, up 340. The third drugs maker, Human put on one percent to finish at 3,085, up 35.
